versions.changelog:
Initial release of security-check skill.

- Enables users to request a free, read-only security check of their own web app or API via Rheono.
- Verifies user consent and authorization before submitting a security check.
- Collects target domain and email to send report.
- Submits requests securely; communicates submission status and any errors.
- No local scanning or account needed—reports are handled and delivered directly by Rheono.
